anti_fishing: No weighted score with post-result weights.
No new architecture may enter after the v1.2 pre-execution lock.
No Track-B or Track-C outcome may influence Track-A primary selection.
No architecture may be retained because it appeared in the preprint.
The preprint MobileNetV4 remains historical evidence regardless of the journal-primary outcome.
R13 was added before any A1/A1.1/A1.2 scientific output was observed; no fifth architecture is authorized after results.

decision_rule.exact_tie: If all listed criteria are exactly tied at recorded precision, report co-primary scientific candidates and defer only the tie to a separately frozen deployment-feasibility gate; do not invent another Track-A experiment.
decision_rule.stage_1: Construct a Pareto frontier using clean predictive quality, worst-seed reliability, class-tail reliability, corruption robustness, and efficiency. A model is dominated only if another is no worse on every considered dimension and strictly better on at least one.
decision_rule.stage_2: If exactly one architecture remains non-dominated, select it as journal-primary.
stage_3: If multiple architectures remain non-dominated, apply this fixed lexicographic order:

eligibility_gates: three intended seeds complete unless a transparent irrecoverable technical failure is documented
selected checkpoint identity and replay integrity PASS
no post-lock tuning or added seeds
architecture implementation remains bound to the frozen family definition
R13 exact timm/model/pretrained-weight identity passes Amendment-G1A before training
excluded_from_primary_architecture_selec: R05 teacher: principal teacher-effect comparator, not a separate architecture candidate
R12 logits/feature: mechanism ablations within MobileNetV4, not primary architecture candidates

handoff.deployment_failure: If Track C later proves the scientific-primary model infeasible under a pre-frozen deployment requirement, record scientific-primary and deployment-primary separately; any fallback must follow a separately frozen rule and may not rewrite Track-A selection.
handoff.track_b: After Track-A selection is sealed, run external validity on the selected journal-primary model under Track-B's independent-cohort protocol.
handoff.track_c: After Track-A selection is sealed, build/validate the journal deployment artifact for the selected architecture. Historical MobileNetV4 PTE evidence remains a historical comparator, not a constraint.

purpose: Select the journal-primary architecture only after all comparative Track-A evidence is complete; no architecture is pre-favored. v1.2 closes the candidate pool at four direct architecture families by adding one modern pure-Transformer reference before amendment science begins.

efficiency: theoretical_MACs_or_FLOPs only if one comparable audited profiler passes all architectures
xai: not assigned a numerical selection weight
no lesion-localization claim without ground-truth lesion masks

forbidden_before_selection: opening Track-B model predictions on an external candidate
must_complete_before_selection: all 12 direct architecture states terminal or transparently failed
selected-checkpoint DS-V1-VAL replay for all successful direct states
three-seed clean metric summaries for all four architecture families
fixed robustness protocol across all successful direct states
120-class tail/confusion analysis across all successful direct states
architecture efficiency context across all four candidate families
Grad-CAM++ explainability/faithfulness audit across all successful direct architecture states
